summary: Challenge to Punjab & Haryana High Court orders dismissing writ petitions; arrest under PMLA s.19(1) challenged as abuse of process; summons issued prior to ECIR linkage; arrests in connection with second ECIR; non-mention in first ECIR or FIRs; procedural compliance with PMLA arrest safeguards questioned; reference to Vijay Madanlal Choudhary, Arnesh Kumar, Satender Kumar Antil; constitutional validity of s.19 upheld; interim protection granted by Delhi HC; SLPs withdrawn with liberty to approach appropriate forum; remand orders challenged; custody extensions by Vacation Judge; attack on gravity of allegations and necessity for custodial interrogation.
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 s.19
Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 s.7, s.8, s.11, s.13
Vijay Madanlal Choudhary v. Union of India
Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned orders set aside; matter remanded for reconsideration in accordance with law and guidelines laid down by this Court.
